pr_title: Add OpenAPI operation and schema transformer interfaces
pr_body:
# Add OpenAPI operation and schema transformer interfaces

Add interfaces for transforming OpenAPI operations and schemas.

## Description

- Add `IOpenApiOperationTransformer`.
- Add `IOpenApiSchemaTransformer`.
- Rename `Use*Transfomer()` methods to `Add*Transformer()`.

Fixes #56022

Test failures seem to be an instance of https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/issues/56828 that is affecting a few other PRs. The particular failrue doesn't seem like a flake but it's not impact all PRs so there might be something here...

review_comments:
This is the one bit of the PR I'm not sure about.

As this stands, when you use `AddSchemaTransformer<T>()`, the type gets activated once for each schema.

This doesn't seem good compared to the document and operation transformers, but I wasn't sure how to restructure things to resolve that based on the way the schemas are separate by then might get de-duped in the components right at the end of generating the document.

Thoughts?
What do the benchmarks show about relative perf of activated schema transformers vs. document-based transformers here?
I'm having trouble getting them to run - what am I missing? https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/56395#discussion_r1657326456
I moved this for re-use so that the operation transformers only get activated from DI once per document, rather than once per operation.
The counts in the assertions likely need updating if the schema activation is changed pending the previous question.

I think this change violates the ordering principle for transformers that we originally established during API review ([ref](https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/issues/54650#issuecomment-2023317760)) where operation transformers are modeled as document transformers and run in FIFO-order based on their registration. Now it seems like if an operation transformer is an activated instance, it'll run in order with document transformers but if it is a delegate or instantiated then it will run before document transformers.

Assuming my assesssment here is correct, we'll probably want to figure out a way to fix this.

I've added a test for operations running FIFO before the document transformers and refactored things so it passes. The trade-off here was that it's one activation per operation now if the dependency is transient, rather than being created once per document.
